name: The caller's event stream: a live feed of selected accounts' events posted to a Slack channel of their choice
description: The caller's event stream: a live feed of selected accounts' events posted to a Slack channel of their choice The caller's event stream: a live feed of selected accounts' events posted to a Slack channel of their choice. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/event_streams/{id}/add_account/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/event_streams/{id}/add_account/
The caller's event stream: a live feed of selected accounts' events posted to a Slack channel of their choice. Per-user — each team member owns at most one stream, and every endpoint is scoped to the caller's own. Delivery runs through a managed CDP destination that is re-provisioned inside the same transaction as every write, so config and delivery can't drift apart.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this event stream.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.; body (body)
